prompt.en: Count by 2s with me: 2, 4, 6, 8. What comes next?
prompt.hi: Chalo 2-2 karke ginte hain: 2, 4, 6, 8… ab aage kya aayega?

prompt.en: Count by 5s: 5, 10, 15, ___, 25. Which number is missing?
prompt.hi: 5-5 karke gino: 5, 10, 15, ___, 25. Beech mein kaunsa number gayab hai?

prompt.en: There are 6 pairs of chappals at the beach. Count them by 2s. How many chappals?
prompt.hi: Beach pe chappal ke 6 jode hain. 2-2 karke gino. Kitni chappal hain?

challenges.hint: Say one number for each pair: 2, 4, …

prompt.en: There are 4 hands. Each hand has 5 fingers. Count by 5s. How many fingers?
prompt.hi: 4 haath hain. Har haath mein 5 ungliyan. 5-5 karke gino, kitni ungliyan?

challenges.hint: Say one number per hand, jumping by 5.

prompt.en: I counted shells by 10s: 10, 20, 30, and there were 3 more shells. So I said there are 3 shells. Did I count right? What should it be?
prompt.hi: Maine shells 10-10 karke gine: 10, 20, 30, aur 3 shells aur the. Toh maine bola 3 shells hain. Kya maine sahi gina? Sahi kya hoga?

challenges.hint: Keep going from 30, do not start again.

prompt.en: A frog starts at 0 and jumps 10 each time on a number line. After 4 jumps, where is it? Now tell it with ₹10 notes: 4 notes of ₹10 make how much?
prompt.hi: Ek mendhak 0 se shuru karke number line pe har baar 10 kudta hai. 4 jump ke baad woh kahan hoga? Ab ₹10 ke notes se batao: ₹10 ke 4 note kitne hue?

challenges.hint: Each jump is 10, and each note is ₹10 too.

prompt.en: In a cricket match, Arjun ran 2 runs, 8 times. How many runs did he make?
prompt.hi: Cricket match mein Arjun ne 8 baar 2-2 run bhaage. Usne kitne run banaye?

challenges.hint: Count by 2s, once for each time he ran.

prompt.en: Golu has 8 pairs of bangles and wants to count them fast. Teach Golu how to count them by 2s, and tell him how many bangles there are.
prompt.hi: Golu ke paas chudiyon ke 8 jode hain aur woh jaldi ginna chahta hai. Golu ko sikhao 2-2 karke kaise ginte hain, aur batao kitni chudiyan hain.

challenges.hint: Talk about the groups and the jumps.

prompt.en: You guessed 40 shells. We counted 38. Was your guess close or far?
prompt.hi: Tumne 40 shells ka guess kiya. Ginne pe 38 nikle. Guess paas tha ya door?

prompt.en: I am going to spread these 8 bangles out in a long line. Before I do it: will there be more bangles, fewer, or the same?
prompt.hi: Main in 8 chudiyon ko ek lambi line mein phaila dungi. Usse pehle batao: chudiyan zyada ho jayengi, kam, ya utni hi?

challenges.hint: When I spread them out, do I add a bangle or take one away?

prompt.en: A mela stall has balloons tied in bunches of 10. There are 6 bunches and 3 single balloons. How many balloons?
prompt.hi: Mele mein ek stall pe gubbare 10-10 ke guchchhe mein bandhe hain. 6 guchchhe hain aur 3 akele gubbare. Kitne gubbare?

challenges.hint: Count bunches by 10s, then add the singles.

prompt.en: I made 4 groups of 10 marbles, and 5 marbles were left. So I said 4 + 5 = 9 marbles. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine 10-10 kanchon ke 4 group banaye aur 5 kanche bache. Toh maine bola 4 + 5 = 9 kanche. Kya main sahi hoon?

prompt.en: We have 5 groups of 10 seeds and 2 extra seeds. Show it with ten-sticks and single beads, then say the number.
prompt.hi: Humare paas beej ke 10-10 wale 5 group hain aur 2 beej alag. Ise ten-stick aur akele moti se dikhao, phir number bolo.

challenges.hint: One ten-stick for each group of 10.

prompt.en: This battery cell is standing up. If I lay it down on its side, will it still be a cylinder?
prompt.hi: Yeh battery khadi hai. Agar main ise lita doon, toh kya yeh tab bhi cylinder rahegi?

challenges.hint: Count its flat circles when it stands. Now count them when it lies down.

prompt.en: How many curved surfaces does a matchbox have?
prompt.hi: Maachis ki dibbi mein kitni curved surfaces hain?

prompt.en: A gas cylinder has flat and curved surfaces. How many flat surfaces does it have?
prompt.hi: Gas cylinder mein chapti aur curved dono surfaces hain. Kitni chapti surfaces hain?

challenges.hint: Count the flat circles at the ends.

prompt.en: If I lay a round steel tiffin box on its side and push it, will it roll?
prompt.hi: Agar main gol steel tiffin ko side pe lita kar dhakka doon, toh kya woh ludhkega?

prompt.en: I say: a cylinder can never slide, because it has a curved side. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Main kehti hoon: cylinder kabhi slide nahi kar sakta, kyunki uski side curved hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

prompt.en: There are 3 bundles of 10 sticks and 4 loose sticks. How many sticks in all?
prompt.hi: 10-10 tilliyon ke 3 bandal hain aur 4 khuli tilliyan. Kul kitni tilliyan?

challenges.hint: Count bundles by 10s, then the loose ones.

prompt.en: Write the number seventy (sattar).
prompt.hi: Sattar (seventy) number mein likho.

prompt.en: Didi wrote sixty-two (baasath) like this: 602. Is it right?
prompt.hi: Didi ne baasath (sixty-two) aise likha: 602. Kya yeh sahi hai?

prompt.en: Say it as a number: 6 tens and 0 ones. Then show it with ₹10 notes.
prompt.hi: 6 dahaai aur 0 ikaai ko number mein bolo. Phir ise ₹10 ke notes se dikhao.

prompt.en: A cricket scoreboard shows 7 in the tens place and 3 in the ones place. How many runs is that? If the team scores 10 more runs, what will the board show?
prompt.hi: Cricket scoreboard pe dahaai ki jagah 7 aur ikaai ki jagah 3 hai. Kitne run hue? Team 10 run aur banaye toh board pe kya aayega?

challenges.hint: 10 more runs adds one more ten.

prompt.en: How many tens make 100?
prompt.hi: Kitni dahaai milke 100 banti hain?

prompt.en: Write chaurasi (eighty-four) as a number.
prompt.hi: Chaurasi (eighty-four) ko number mein likho.

challenges.hint: Eighty is 8 tens; write the tens first.

prompt.en: Which is bigger: 45 or 72?
prompt.hi: Kaun bada hai: 45 ya 72?

prompt.en: Which is bigger: 39 or 41?
prompt.hi: Kaun bada hai: 39 ya 41?

challenges.hint: 3 tens and 4 tens: which is more?

prompt.en: What number comes just after 69?
prompt.hi: 69 ke turant baad kaunsa number aata hai?

prompt.en: 58 and 85 use the same digits. Which is bigger, and why?
prompt.hi: 58 aur 85 mein same digits hain. Kaun bada hai, aur kyun?

challenges.hint: The digit in the tens place matters most.

prompt.en: 42 and 47 both have 4 tens. So what will decide which one is bigger? Which one is it?
prompt.hi: 42 aur 47 dono mein 4 dahaai hain. Toh kaun decide karega ki kaun bada hai? Kaunsa bada hai?

challenges.hint: The tens are the same. What is left to compare?

prompt.en: I put these bus numbers in order from small to big: 41, 29, 38. Is my order right?
prompt.hi: Maine bus numbers ko chhote se bade ke kram mein lagaya: 41, 29, 38. Kya mera kram sahi hai?

challenges.hint: Check the tens of each number.

prompt.en: On a number line from 0 to 100, is 48 closer to 40 or to 50?
prompt.hi: 0 se 100 wali number line pe, 48 kiske zyada paas hai, 40 ke ya 50 ke?

challenges.hint: Count the steps both ways on the line.

prompt.en: Which is smaller: 70 or 17?
prompt.hi: Kaun chhota hai: 70 ya 17?

challenges.hint: How many tens does each have?

prompt.en: Which is more money: ₹8 or ₹15?
prompt.hi: Kaun zyada paise hain: ₹8 ya ₹15?

challenges.hint: A two-digit number has at least one ten.

prompt.en: On the 100 grid, what number is just to the right of 26?
prompt.hi: 100 grid pe 26 ke theek right side kaunsa number hai?

prompt.en: On the 100 grid, going down one row adds how much?
prompt.hi: 100 grid pe ek row neeche jaane se kitna badhta hai?

challenges.hint: Down is a whole row more.

prompt.en: Which number is at the end of the row that starts with 41?
prompt.hi: Jo row 41 se shuru hoti hai, uske end mein kaunsa number hai?

prompt.en: This square is turned so a corner points up. I say it is a diamond, not a square. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Yeh square aise ghuma hai ki kona upar hai. Main kehti hoon yeh diamond hai, square nahi. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Count its sides and check their lengths.

prompt.en: There is a tiny triangle on a samosa and a big triangle on a kite. Are both triangles? How do you know?
prompt.hi: Samose pe chhota triangle hai aur patang pe bada triangle. Kya dono triangle hain? Kaise pata?

challenges.hint: Size does not change the shape name.

prompt.en: How many sides does a triangle have?
prompt.hi: Triangle ki kitni sides hoti hain?

prompt.en: How many corners does a square have?
prompt.hi: Square ke kitne kone hote hain?

challenges.hint: A corner is where two sides meet.

prompt.en: How many corners does a circle have?
prompt.hi: Circle ke kitne kone hote hain?

challenges.hint: A circle is round all the way.

prompt.en: One triangle points up. Another triangle is long and thin and points sideways. Are both triangles?
prompt.hi: Ek triangle upar ki taraf hai. Doosra lamba, patla aur side ki taraf hai. Kya dono triangle hain?

challenges.hint: Direction does not change the name.

prompt.en: I counted the sides of a square: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5! So it has 5 sides. Check me.
prompt.hi: Maine square ki sides ginin: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5! Toh 5 sides hain. Check karo.

challenges.hint: Mark the first side, and stop when you reach it again.

prompt.en: With 3 matchsticks, make a closed shape. What is it called and how many corners does it have?
prompt.hi: 3 maachis ki tilliyon se ek band shape banao. Uska naam kya hai aur kitne kone hain?

challenges.hint: Join every end so there are no gaps.

prompt.en: Which has more corners: a triangle or a rectangle?
prompt.hi: Kiske zyada kone hain: triangle ya rectangle?

challenges.hint: How many corners does each have?

prompt.en: A slide in the park makes what kind of line: standing, sleeping or slanting?
prompt.hi: Park ki slide kaisi line banati hai: khadi, leti ya tirchi?

challenges.hint: It leans from high to low.

prompt.en: I said the letter V has curved lines because they are tilted. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Maine kaha V akshar mein curved lines hain kyunki woh tirchi hain. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: Tilted is not the same as curved.

prompt.en: What is 23 + 14?
prompt.hi: 23 + 14 kitna hai?

prompt.en: Didi has 32 diyas. Mummy gives her 6 more. How many diyas now?
prompt.hi: Didi ke paas 32 diye hain. Mummy ne 6 aur diye. Ab kitne diye?

prompt.en: What is 27 + 15?
prompt.hi: 27 + 15 kitna hai?

prompt.en: What is 48 + 36?
prompt.hi: 48 + 36 kitna hai?

prompt.en: We are going to add 26 + 17. Before adding: will the ones (6 + 7) make a new ten?
prompt.hi: Hum 26 + 17 karenge. Jodne se pehle batao: kya ikaai (6 + 7) se nayi dahaai banegi?

challenges.hint: If the ones are 10 or more, we make a new ten.

prompt.en: For rangoli, Sana used 35 red flowers and 28 yellow flowers. How many flowers did she use?
prompt.hi: Rangoli ke liye Sana ne 35 laal phool aur 28 peele phool lagaye. Kul kitne phool?

prompt.en: I added 36 + 25 and got 511. Check my work!
prompt.hi: Maine 36 + 25 joda aur 511 aaya. Mera kaam check karo!

prompt.en: Show 19 + 23 with ₹10 notes and ₹1 coins. How much money is there in all?
prompt.hi: 19 + 23 ko ₹10 ke notes aur ₹1 ke sikkon se dikhao. Kul kitne paise hue?

challenges.hint: 1 note and 9 coins, plus 2 notes and 3 coins.

prompt.en: In a cricket match, Ravi scored 46 runs and Ali scored 38 runs. How many runs did they score together? Did they cross 80?
prompt.hi: Cricket match mein Ravi ne 46 run banaye aur Ali ne 38. Dono ne milke kitne run banaye? Kya 80 paar hua?

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to add 28 + 14 using tens and ones.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao ki 28 + 14 dahaai aur ikaai se kaise jodte hain.

prompt.en: What is 40 + 30?
prompt.hi: 40 + 30 kitna hai?

prompt.en: One box has 45 bangles and another has 29 bangles. How many bangles in all?
prompt.hi: Ek dibbe mein 45 chudiyan hain aur doosre mein 29. Kul kitni chudiyan?

prompt.en: What is 48 − 23?
prompt.hi: 48 − 23 kitna hai?

prompt.en: There were 36 balloons. 4 burst. How many are left?
prompt.hi: 36 gubbare the. 4 phoot gaye. Kitne bache?

prompt.en: There were 42 balloons for decoration. 18 burst. How many are left?
prompt.hi: Sajaavat ke liye 42 gubbare the. 18 phoot gaye. Kitne bache?

prompt.en: What is 50 − 26?
prompt.hi: 50 − 26 kitna hai?

challenges.hint: There are 0 ones, so break 1 ten into 10 ones.

prompt.en: For 53 − 27, will we need to break a ten? How can you tell before solving?
prompt.hi: 53 − 27 mein kya dahaai todni padegi? Hal karne se pehle kaise pata chalega?

challenges.hint: If the top ones are fewer, we break a ten.

prompt.en: A train coach has 65 seats. 38 people are sitting. How many seats are empty?
prompt.hi: Train ke ek dibbe mein 65 seat hain. 38 log baithe hain. Kitni seat khaali hain?

challenges.hint: Break a ten: 15 ones and 5 tens.

prompt.en: I did 64 − 29 and got 45. Check me!
prompt.hi: Maine 64 − 29 kiya aur 45 aaya. Check karo!

challenges.hint: Can we take 9 from 4? We must break a ten.

prompt.en: You have ₹70. A kite costs ₹45. How much money is left after buying it?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹70 hain. Patang ₹45 ki hai. Khareedne ke baad kitne paise bachenge?

prompt.en: What is 90 − 40?
prompt.hi: 90 − 40 kitna hai?

prompt.en: Ravi had 71 marbles. He gave away 35. How many are left?
prompt.hi: Ravi ke paas 71 kanche the. Usne 35 de diye. Kitne bache?

challenges.hint: Break a ten: 11 ones and 6 tens.

prompt.en: What is 34 + 10?
prompt.hi: 34 + 10 kitna hai?

prompt.en: What is 72 − 10?
prompt.hi: 72 − 10 kitna hai?

prompt.en: What is 25 + 9? Try adding 10, then taking away 1.
prompt.hi: 25 + 9 kitna hai? Pehle 10 jodo, phir 1 ghatao.

prompt.en: What is 53 − 9?
prompt.hi: 53 − 9 kitna hai?

prompt.en: At the flower stall, one garland costs ₹15 and a bunch of roses costs ₹9. What is the total? Do it in your head.
prompt.hi: Phoolon ki dukaan pe ek maala ₹15 ki hai aur gulaab ka guchchha ₹9 ka. Kul kitna? Dimaag mein karo.

prompt.en: I did 64 + 9 like this: 64 + 10 = 74, then 1 more = 75. Check me.
prompt.hi: Maine 64 + 9 aise kiya: 64 + 10 = 74, phir 1 aur = 75. Check karo.

challenges.hint: We added 1 extra, so take 1 away.

prompt.en: On a number line, start at 26 and make 3 jumps of 10. Where do you land? Say it as an addition sentence.
prompt.hi: Number line pe 26 se shuru karke 10-10 ki 3 chhalaang lagao. Kahan pahunche? Ise jod ke vaakya mein bolo.

prompt.en: A bus had 48 people. At the next stop, 11 more got on. How many people are on the bus now? Do it in your head.
prompt.hi: Bus mein 48 log the. Agle stop pe 11 aur chadhe. Ab bus mein kitne log hain? Dimaag mein karo.

prompt.en: What is 10 more than 65?
prompt.hi: 65 se 10 zyada kitna hai?

prompt.en: Use doubles: 7 + 7 = 14. So what is 7 + 8?
prompt.hi: Doubles se socho: 7 + 7 = 14. Toh 7 + 8 kitna hoga?

prompt.en: When we measure with paper clips, should we leave gaps between the clips?
prompt.hi: Paper clips se naapte waqt kya clips ke beech jagah chhodni chahiye?

challenges.hint: A gap is length we did not count.

prompt.en: {friendF} says her dupatta is 9 hand-spans long. Dadi says her dupatta is 7 hand-spans. Can we say {friendF}'s is longer? What should they do?
prompt.hi: {friendF} kehti hai uska dupatta 9 baalisht hai. Dadi kehti hain unka 7 baalisht. Kya hum keh sakte hain {friendF} ka lamba hai? Unhe kya karna chahiye?

prompt.en: I measured a stick with matchboxes, but I kept spaces between them. I got 4 matchboxes. Is my measuring right?
prompt.hi: Maine ek lakdi ko maachis ki dibbiyon se naapa, par beech mein jagah chhodi. 4 dibbi aayi. Kya maine sahi naapa?

challenges.hint: Gaps are length we did not count.

prompt.en: A ribbon is 6 blocks long. Each block is as long as 2 clips. How many clips long is the ribbon? Show it with blocks and clips.
prompt.hi: Ek ribbon 6 block lamba hai. Har block 2 clip ke barabar hai. Ribbon kitni clip lamba hai? Blocks aur clips se dikhao.

prompt.en: If we measure with bigger units, do we need more of them or fewer?
prompt.hi: Agar badi units se naapein, toh zyada lagengi ya kam?

challenges.hint: Each big unit covers more length.

prompt.en: A ribbon is 4 clips long. Another ribbon is 2 clips longer. How long is the second ribbon in clips?
prompt.hi: Ek ribbon 4 clip lamba hai. Doosra ribbon 2 clip zyada lamba hai. Doosra ribbon kitni clip ka hai?

prompt.en: A bucket fills 8 mugs. A tub fills 12 mugs. How many more mugs does the tub hold?
prompt.hi: Ek baalti se 8 mug bharte hain. Ek tub se 12 mug. Tub mein kitne mug zyada aate hain?

prompt.en: An apple balances 3 marbles exactly. Now we put the apple on one side and 5 marbles on the other. Which side goes down?
prompt.hi: Ek seb 3 kanchon ke barabar tolta hai. Ab ek taraf seb aur doosri taraf 5 kanche rakhe. Kaunsa palda neeche jaayega?

prompt.en: On the balance, the onion side went up and the potato side went down. I say the onion is heavier. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Taraazu pe pyaaz wala palda upar gaya aur aloo wala neeche. Main kehti hoon pyaaz bhaari hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

prompt.en: The kettle fills 5 cups and the jug fills 3 cups. Show it as towers of cups. How many more cups does the kettle fill?
prompt.hi: Kettle se 5 cup bharte hain aur jug se 3 cup. Ise cups ke towers se dikhao. Kettle se kitne cup zyada bharte hain?

prompt.en: On a balance, does the heavier thing go up or down?
prompt.hi: Taraazu pe bhaari cheez upar jaati hai ya neeche?

challenges.hint: Think of a see-saw with a big child on one side and a small child on the other.

prompt.en: There are 3 plates with 2 rotis on each. How many rotis?
prompt.hi: 3 plate hain, har plate pe 2 roti. Kul kitni roti?

challenges.hint: Count by 2s, once for each plate.

prompt.en: Three bags have 2, 2 and 4 mangoes. Are these equal groups?
prompt.hi: 3 thailon mein 2, 2 aur 4 aam hain. Kya yeh barabar group hain?

prompt.en: There are 5 auto-rickshaws with 3 children in each. How many children?
prompt.hi: 5 auto-rickshaw hain, har ek mein 3 bachche. Kul kitne bachche?

challenges.hint: Count by 3s, once for each auto.

prompt.en: There are 6 pencil boxes with 2 pencils in each. How many pencils?
prompt.hi: 6 pencil box hain, har ek mein 2 pencil. Kul kitni pencil?

prompt.en: I said 4 groups of 3 is 7, because 4 and 3 make 7. Check me.
prompt.hi: Maine kaha 3 ke 4 group 7 hote hain, kyunki 4 aur 3 milke 7. Check karo.

challenges.hint: Count 3 for each of the 4 groups.

prompt.en: In cricket, one over has 6 balls. How many balls are bowled in 3 overs?
prompt.hi: Cricket mein ek over mein 6 ball hoti hain. 3 over mein kitni ball phenki jaati hain?

prompt.en: What is 4 times 2?
prompt.hi: 4 guna 2 kitna hota hai?

prompt.en: Share 12 jalebis equally among 4 cousins. How many does each cousin get?
prompt.hi: 12 jalebi 4 cousins mein barabar baanto. Har cousin ko kitni?

prompt.en: 20 chocolates are put equally into 5 bags. How many chocolates in each bag?
prompt.hi: 20 chocolate 5 thailon mein barabar daale. Har thaile mein kitni?

prompt.en: Show 8 rotis shared by 4 people on plates. Then say it as groups: 4 groups of ___ make 8.
prompt.hi: 8 roti 4 logon mein plate pe baant ke dikhao. Phir group mein bolo: ___ ke 4 group milke 8.

challenges.hint: Deal one at a time to 4 plates.

prompt.en: 18 children want to make 3 teams of the same size for kho-kho. How many children will be in each team?
prompt.hi: 18 bachche kho-kho ke liye barabar size ki 3 team banana chahte hain. Har team mein kitne bachche honge?

challenges.hint: Put one child in each team, round and round.

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to share 12 jalebis among 4 cousins fairly.
prompt.hi: Golu ko sikhao ki 12 jalebi 4 cousins mein barabar kaise baantein.

prompt.en: I said the months in order: January, February, April, March. Did I get it right?
prompt.hi: Maine mahine kram se bole: January, February, April, March. Kya maine sahi bola?

challenges.hint: Say the months slowly from January.

prompt.en: How many days are there in a week?
prompt.hi: Ek hafte mein kitne din hote hain?

prompt.en: It rained one day in February. Does that mean the monsoon has come? Why?
prompt.hi: February mein ek din baarish hui. Kya iska matlab monsoon aa gaya? Kyun?

challenges.hint: A season is the usual weather for many weeks.

prompt.en: In Delhi, which months are the hottest: December and January, or May and June?
prompt.hi: Delhi mein sabse garam mahine kaunse hote hain: December-January, ya May-June?

challenges.hint: December and January are when we wear sweaters.

prompt.en: I say: the monsoon rain reaches every city in India on the same day. Am I right?
prompt.hi: Main kehti hoon: monsoon ki baarish Bharat ke har shehar mein ek hi din pahunchti hai. Kya main sahi hoon?

challenges.hint: The monsoon moves across India over weeks.

prompt.en: Is winter only one month long?
prompt.hi: Kya sardi sirf ek mahine ki hoti hai?

prompt.en: Which is worth more: a ₹10 note or a ₹2 coin?
prompt.hi: Kiski keemat zyada hai: ₹10 ka note ya ₹2 ka sikka?

prompt.en: How much money is this: one ₹50 note, two ₹10 notes and one ₹5 coin?
prompt.hi: Yeh kitne paise hain: ₹50 ka ek note, ₹10 ke do note aur ₹5 ka ek sikka?

prompt.en: Three ₹5 coins make how many rupees?
prompt.hi: ₹5 ke 3 sikke kitne rupaye hue?

challenges.hint: Count by 5s, once for each coin.

prompt.en: Purse A has one ₹50 note. Purse B has five ₹10 notes. Which purse has more money?
prompt.hi: Purse A mein ₹50 ka ek note hai. Purse B mein ₹10 ke paanch note. Kis purse mein zyada paise hain?

prompt.en: I have a ₹10 note, a ₹5 coin and a ₹2 coin. I say that is ₹3. Check me.
prompt.hi: Mere paas ₹10 ka note, ₹5 ka sikka aur ₹2 ka sikka hai. Main kehti hoon yeh ₹3 hain. Check karo.

challenges.hint: Add the numbers written on them.

prompt.en: You have only ₹20 notes and ₹5 coins. Can you make exactly ₹65? How?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas sirf ₹20 ke note aur ₹5 ke sikke hain. Kya exactly ₹65 bana sakte ho? Kaise?

prompt.en: How many ₹10 notes make ₹100?
prompt.hi: ₹10 ke kitne note milke ₹100 bante hain?

prompt.en: An old, big ₹1 coin and a newer, smaller ₹5 coin. Which can buy more, and how do you know?
prompt.hi: Ek purana bada ₹1 ka sikka aur ek naya chhota ₹5 ka sikka. Kisse zyada khareed sakte ho, aur kaise pata?

challenges.hint: Size does not tell the value.

prompt.en: A pencil costs ₹5 and an eraser costs ₹3. How much for both?
prompt.hi: Pencil ₹5 ki hai aur rubber ₹3 ka. Dono ke kitne paise?

prompt.en: A balloon costs ₹12 and a whistle costs ₹15. How much for both?
prompt.hi: Gubbara ₹12 ka hai aur seeti ₹15 ki. Dono ke kitne paise?

prompt.en: A toy costs ₹35. You pay with a ₹50 note. How much change do you get?
prompt.hi: Khilona ₹35 ka hai. Tumne ₹50 ka note diya. Kitne paise wapas milenge?

prompt.en: Chips cost ₹10. You pay ₹20. How much change?
prompt.hi: Chips ₹10 ke hain. Tumne ₹20 diye. Kitne wapas milenge?

prompt.en: A kite costs ₹45 and you give ₹50. Before working it out: will the change be more or less than ₹10? Then find it.
prompt.hi: Patang ₹45 ki hai aur tum ₹50 dete ho. Hisaab se pehle batao: wapas ₹10 se zyada milenge ya kam? Phir nikalo.

challenges.hint: The price is very close to the note.

prompt.en: You have ₹40. A book costs ₹25 and a pen costs ₹10. Can you buy both? How much will be left?
prompt.hi: Tumhare paas ₹40 hain. Kitaab ₹25 ki aur pen ₹10 ka. Kya dono khareed sakte ho? Kitne bachenge?

prompt.en: I bought a toffee box for ₹28 and paid ₹50. I got ₹38 change. Is that right?
prompt.hi: Maine ₹28 ka toffee ka dabba khareeda aur ₹50 diye. Mujhe ₹38 wapas mile. Kya yeh sahi hai?

challenges.hint: We cannot take 8 from 0; break a ten.

prompt.en: At the mela, a giant-wheel ride costs ₹30 and candy floss costs ₹15. You have ₹50. Can you do both? How much will be left?
prompt.hi: Mele mein giant-wheel ki sawaari ₹30 ki aur candy floss ₹15 ki hai. Tumhare paas ₹50 hain. Kya dono kar sakte ho? Kitne bachenge?

prompt.en: The price is ₹20 and you paid ₹50. How much change?
prompt.hi: Daam ₹20 hai aur tumne ₹50 diye. Kitne wapas milenge?

prompt.en: Show 3 with tally marks.
prompt.hi: Tally marks se 3 dikhao.

prompt.en: A tally shows 1 bundle of 5 and 3 more lines. How many is that?
prompt.hi: Ek tally mein 5 ka 1 bundle aur 3 line aur hain. Kitne hue?

challenges.hint: A bundle is 5; count on the lines.

prompt.en: There are 2 bundles of 5 tally marks. How many is that?
prompt.hi: 5 ke 2 tally bundle hain. Kitne hue?

prompt.en: I made tally marks for 7 children: 7 standing lines in a row. Is that the right way?
prompt.hi: Maine 7 bachchon ke liye tally banaye: ek line mein 7 khadi lines. Kya yeh sahi tareeka hai?

challenges.hint: Make a bundle at 5, then keep going.

prompt.en: Teach Golu how to make tally marks up to 10.
prompt.hi: Golu ko 10 tak tally marks banana sikhao.

prompt.en: In tally marks, what number does one bundle (4 lines with 1 across) show?
prompt.hi: Tally marks mein ek bundle (4 line aur 1 aadi) kaunsa number dikhata hai?

prompt.en: In the pictograph, the cycle row has 6 cycle pictures. How many cycles passed the school gate?
prompt.hi: Pictograph mein cycle wali row mein 6 cycle ki tasveerein hain. School gate se kitni cycle guzri?

prompt.en: Autos: 8, cars: 5. How many more autos than cars?
prompt.hi: Auto: 8, car: 5. Car se kitne zyada auto hain?

prompt.en: Two pictographs show the same data. One uses big pictures and one uses small pictures. Do the answers change?
prompt.hi: Do pictograph ek hi data dikhate hain. Ek mein badi tasveerein hain, ek mein chhoti. Kya jawab badalte hain?

challenges.hint: We count pictures, not their size.

prompt.en: A favourite-sweet pictograph shows jalebi 7, laddoo 4 and rasgulla 5. How many children were asked in all?
prompt.hi: Pasandida mithai ke pictograph mein jalebi 7, laddoo 4 aur rasgulla 5 hain. Kul kitne bachchon se poochha gaya?

prompt.en: Jalebi has 7 pictures and laddoo has 4. The question is: how many more children chose jalebi? I said 11. Check me.
prompt.hi: Jalebi ki 7 tasveerein aur laddoo ki 4. Sawaal: kitne zyada bachchon ne jalebi chuni? Maine kaha 11. Check karo.

prompt.en: One row has 9 pictures and another has 6. How many more are in the first row?
prompt.hi: Ek row mein 9 tasveerein hain aur doosri mein 6. Pehli row mein kitni zyada hain?
